QuestInfo.name: [LINE FRIENDS] Worth a Thousand Words
QuestInfo.0: The pepped-up CONY wants to ask something of you. What will this mysterious request entail? There's only one way to find out.
QuestInfo.1: The pepped-up CONY wants to ask something of you. What will this mysterious request entail? There's only one way to find out.
QuestInfo.2:
CONY believes the trip just won't have that good ol' vacation magic without pictures of Maple World's #bfamous people#k, #bfamous places#k, and #bfamous monsters#k.
If you bring her #b3 pictures at a time,#k you can exchange them for rewards up to 3 times per day!
You agreed to take all the pictures she could want, keeping in mind that you should vary up your photos, and that the camera's flash needs time to charge back up after every use.
